ORDINANCE VI OF 2005
ORDINANCE VI OF 2005
LEGAL
PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2005
An Ordinance further to amend
the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 11th April, 2005]
No. F.2(I)/2005-Pub., dated 8-4-2005.-The following Ordinance
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And Whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of
the "powers conferred by clause (I)-of Article 89 of the Constitution of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:-‑
1. Short title, and commencement etc.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils (Amendment) Ordinance,
2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 3rd day of March, 2005.
(3) The provisions of this
Ordinance shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other law
or rules for the time being in force.

And Whereas the National Assembly
is not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of
the "powers conferred by clause (I)-of Article 89 of the Constitution of
the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance:-‑
2. Amendment of section 2,
Act XXXV of 1973.---In the Legal Practitioners and Bar
Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 2,--‑
(1) clause (cc) shall be omitted;
(2) for clause (e), the following
shall be substituted, namely:---"()) `Legal practitioner' means an
advocate;";
(3) after clause (k), the
following new clauses shall be inserted, namely: -‑
"(kk) `roll
of group of districts' means a roll of advocates of a High Court or, as the
case may be, a roll of advocates practising in a former Revenue Division as
existed on the 31st December, 1999, prepared and maintained by a Provincial Bar
Council under this Act;
(kkk) `Schedule'
means Schedule to this Act;"; and
(4) in clause (n), for the full
stop at the end the semi-colon shall be substituted and thereafter the
following new clause shall be added, namely:--‑
"(o)
`voter' means--‑
(i) in relation
to election to a Provincial Bar Council, an advocate whose name for the time
being appears on the roll of group of districts and to whom an identity card
has been issued by a Provincial 'Bar Council and who is not in arrears of dues
of the Provincial Bar Council for a period exceeding six months; and
(ii) in relation
to election to the Pakistan Bar Council, a member of a Provincial Bar
Council.".
